approval.direction: User selected variation 3: rope-edged walnut, from the five divider-free previews.
approval.latest_correction: Final blank production frame has one continuous parchment interior, rope/walnut perimeter and four outer brass corners. There is no divider, portrait aperture or separate portrait backing. The live portrait renders over shared paper; the title is raised onto the top rail.
approval.scene_status: Composition and colours accepted as a guide; carpet markings need simplification. Room image is not a final camera-matched backdrop.

layout.coordinate_format: x, y, width, height; logical pixels at 1920x1080; source rectangles use native PNG pixels
layout.frame_rendering: Three adjacent horizontal slices of one unchanged texture; two fixed outer caps and a middle stretched horizontally. One continuous parchment field, with no internal divider or portrait aperture.
layout.alignment: One continuous bar, top 720 and bottom 1020. The ribbon sits on the upper rail.
layout.portrait_note: Render the transparent live head over the shared parchment within this viewport. No separate backing colour, portrait frame or aperture mask. Keep the face and animated features within the viewport.
layer_order: ribbon, response highlights and control sprites
layout.sizing_rule: Long speech and wrapped responses scroll within 188px. Content never enlarges the 300px bar. Use the adjacent source/destination rectangles; do not stretch the full PNG into the bar.
layout.responsive_rule: Scale the logical canvas uniformly. If adapting width at 300px height, keep both outer 100px caps fixed and resize only the middle span.

typography.note: These are actual supplied fonts for live engine text. AI mockup lettering is illustrative and does not embed these font files.

speech.label: speaker name
speech.auto_follow: Only while the reader is already at the bottom. Preserve manual scroll-back.
speech.continue: First activation finishes typewriter reveal; next advances. Scroll actions are never advance actions.

responses.portrait: responding player character as shown in the selected concept
responses.label: localised Your response
responses.wrapped_rows: Grow to fit text; fewer rows are visible when wrapping. Four 44px single-line rows plus three 4px gaps exactly fill the 188px viewport. Panel remains 300px high.
responses.focus: Selected background plus brass outline and chevron; keep live numbers.
responses.activation: Mouse click or explicit confirm action, not scroll wheel or focus navigation.

dialogue_frame.background: Transparent exterior. The continuous parchment interior has no transparent portrait hole; broad paper sample alpha 252..254, median 253/255.

slices.behavior: Fixed proportions; preserves the left rope/walnut edge and outer brass corners.
Stretch horizontally only through the long rails and continuous paper. Modest horizontal extension is acceptable at the design width; no tiling algorithm is required.
Fixed proportions; preserves the right rope/walnut edge and outer brass corners.

dialogue_frame.runtime_method: Draw the three atlas regions into adjacent destination rectangles in one fixed Control host; all use the same source and meet at x180 and x1740. Draw the transparent live portrait over shared parchment. Keep live text, ribbon, highlights and controls separate. Preserve source alpha and do not overlay legacy frames.

speaker_ribbon.background: true alpha transparency outside the shape

nine_slice.godot_method: A fixed-size unscaled Control host owns the visual NinePatchRect child. Use the atlas region as NinePatchRect.region_rect, child scale (texture_scale, texture_scale), local child size target_size / texture_scale, and patch margins in source pixels. The visual child must not be a direct child of a Container. Keep live text and hit targets in the unscaled host.
